prerequisite_rule: Needs CATAN base game.
what_it_adds: Two more player colors, extra hexes and cards, and a turn rule that keeps everyone involved so 5 or 6 can play.
verdict_reason: Only buy this if you regularly have five or six players. Each expansion then needs its own matching 5-6 box too.
notes: 6th edition product page; min/max = 5-6 players per publisher.

prerequisite_rule: Needs CATAN base game.
what_it_adds: Ships, a pirate, gold fields, new islands to settle and a campaign of nine map setups.
what_it_fixes: Long-time players find the same board stale; adds sea exploration.
verdict_reason: Seafarers is the first CATAN expansion I'd buy. It adds islands and ships without making the game much heavier.
notes: Shop page showed 'Notify me when available' (may be out of stock). Publisher calls it an ideal first expansion (marketing claim not a review).

prerequisite_rule: Needs base game, Seafarers and the base 5-6 extension (four boxes total).
what_it_adds: Extra pieces so 5 or 6 players can play Seafarers.
verdict_reason: Only worth it if you own Seafarers and often play with five or six. It also needs the base-game 5-6 extension.
notes: Price not fetched.

prerequisite_rule: Needs CATAN base game.
what_it_adds: Knights, barbarian attacks, commodities, city improvements and progress cards. Game goes to 13 points.
what_it_fixes: Base game feels too simple; adds city upgrades, knights and barbarian attacks.
verdict_reason: Cities & Knights is worth it once your group wants a deeper, longer game. It's the biggest change to how CATAN plays.
notes: Publisher says it is longer and tougher (90-120 min vs 60-90 base); age 12+.

requires_also: CATAN – The Game 5-6 Player Expansion;Cities & Knights
prerequisite_rule: Needs base game, Cities & Knights and the base 5-6 extension (four boxes total).
what_it_adds: Extra pieces so 5 or 6 players can play Cities & Knights.
verdict_reason: Only worth it if you own Cities & Knights and often play with five or six. It also needs the base-game 5-6 extension.
notes: Price not fetched.

prerequisite_rule: Needs CATAN base game.
what_it_adds: A box of variants: 2-player rules, event cards instead of dice, fishermen, rivers, and a five-scenario campaign.
what_it_fixes: Adds variety without a big rules jump, including gentle scenarios for newer players.
verdict_reason: Traders & Barbarians is a box of smaller variants, including 2-player rules. Get it after Seafarers and Cities & Knights.
notes: Only core expansion that enables 2-player CATAN (per publisher).

requires_also: CATAN – The Game 5-6 Player Expansion;Traders & Barbarians
prerequisite_rule: Needs base game, Traders & Barbarians and the base 5-6 extension (four boxes total).
what_it_adds: Extra pieces so 5 or 6 players can play Traders & Barbarians.
verdict_reason: Only worth it if you own Traders & Barbarians and often play with five or six. It also needs the base-game 5-6 extension.
notes: Price not fetched.

prerequisite_rule: Needs CATAN base game.
what_it_adds: Ships that move freely, hidden islands, and missions: fight pirate lairs, haul fish, and trade spices.
what_it_fixes: Open sandbox play feels aimless; adds missions, exploring and pirates.
verdict_reason: Explorers & Pirates is for groups that already love CATAN and want a campaign-style twist. It can't be combined with Cities & Knights.
notes: Age 12+ and 90-120 min per publisher; shop URL says pre-order.

requires_also: CATAN – The Game 5-6 Player Expansion;Explorers & Pirates
prerequisite_rule: Needs base game, Explorers & Pirates and the base 5-6 extension (four boxes total).
what_it_adds: Extra pieces so 5 or 6 players can play Explorers & Pirates.
verdict_reason: Only worth it if you own Explorers & Pirates and often play with five or six. It also needs the base-game 5-6 extension.
notes: Price not fetched.

prerequisite_rule: Needs CATAN base game and Seafarers.
what_it_adds: A four-part story campaign built on Seafarers. Points carry over between chapters, with treasure chests and combat cards along the way.
verdict_reason: Only worth it if you own Seafarers and play with the same 3-4 people. It is a four-part story campaign, and the US edition is out of print.
notes: 2026-09-29: ranked from a BGG review + BGG/Reddit player threads. CATAN Shop lists it as no longer available (was $37), so no price shown. 2-player rules exist as a PDF but players say they are weak. 6th-edition compatibility not verified.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the original Ticket to Ride (USA).
what_it_adds: 181 large cards: 35 new tickets, a Globetrotter bonus, a full replacement card deck, and three new ways to play.
verdict_reason: USA 1910 adds more tickets and bigger cards to the original game. It only works with the original USA box, not Europe.
notes: Card expansion; USA only (not Europe). Price not fetched.

requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: Two maps: Team Asia (play in pairs) and Legendary Asia. Includes card holders and extra trains.
verdict_reason: Asia is well worth it, especially the Team Asia map for up to six. It's a good second or third map pack.
notes: Volume numbers inferred from rulebook codes T2RMC1..8; verify before displaying numbers.

requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: Two maps: India (bonus for loop routes) and Switzerland (made for 2-3 players).
verdict_reason: The India map is the reason to buy this pack. Switzerland is a tight map for two or three.
notes: Price not fetched.

expansion_name: Map Collection Vol. 3: The Heart of Africa
requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: An Africa map plus terrain cards that make some routes worth more.
verdict_reason: Heart of Africa is fine, but reviewers say to get the other map packs first.
notes: Designer says it adds a third card deck (publisher page).

requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: A Netherlands map with bridge toll tokens; money matters for the first time.
what_it_fixes: Adds a money twist to contested bridge routes.
verdict_reason: Nederland is a great pick if you often play with two or three. Its bridge tolls add tension without much extra rules.
notes: Price not fetched.

expansion_name: Map Collection Vol. 5: United Kingdom & Pennsylvania
requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: UK map (2-4) with tech cards you buy to unlock routes; Pennsylvania map (2-5) with stock shares.
what_it_fixes: Adds new strategy layers for groups who want more than route racing.
verdict_reason: UK & Pennsylvania adds more complexity than most map packs. Get it only if your group actively wants that.
notes: Designer says UK changes the base system more than any other map.

expansion_name: Map Collection Vol. 6: France & Old West
requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: France map where you lay track before claiming it; Old West map for up to 6 with home cities.
what_it_fixes: Lets bigger groups play and changes how routes are claimed.
verdict_reason: France & Old West gets strong fans and some reviewers who'd pass. Buy it if you want a sixth player or a twist on track building.
notes: Includes a new set of trains (6th color) per publisher; 60-90 min.

requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: A Poland map with country cards for linking neighboring countries.
verdict_reason: Poland is a small pack reviewers call not a must buy. Skip it unless you're collecting every map.
notes: Poland page itself does not state the base; general Map Collection line says USA or Europe.

requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe for trains and cards.
what_it_adds: Japan map with a shared bullet-train network; Italy map with ferry routes and region bonuses.
what_it_fixes: Base map feels solved; adds a shared build project and new scoring goals.
verdict_reason: Japan & Italy is the map pack I'd start with. Reviewers call it a fan favorite and a perfect place to start.
notes: Price not fetched.

expansion_name: Map Collection Vol. 8: Iberia & South Korea
requires_also: Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe
prerequisite_rule: Needs Ticket to Ride or Ticket to Ride: Europe (stated on product page).
what_it_adds: Iberia map with festival card sets; South Korea map with province scoring and express train cards.
verdict_reason: Iberia & South Korea is best for groups that already know Ticket to Ride well. It's a newer pack, so start elsewhere.
notes: Includes 110 train car cards. Designer says it adds little complexity. Player-count conflict: Wikipedia says both maps are 2-4; tabletopinfo says 2-5. CSV value kept pending a publisher check.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 18 tiles with inns and cathedrals, a big meeple, 6th-player pieces and 50/100 point tiles.
what_it_fixes: Lets a sixth player join and adds big-score gambles without much extra rules.
verdict_reason: Inns & Cathedrals is the first Carcassonne expansion to buy. It adds a sixth player and bigger scoring without changing the game's feel.
notes: Expansion 1. Adds the 6th player. Store page price did not render.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 24 tiles, goods tokens, builder (extra tile turns), pig for farms, and a cloth bag for tiles.
what_it_fixes: Adds reasons to finish cities and more scoring depth.
verdict_reason: Traders & Builders is the natural second box. It adds goods and a builder that make turns more interesting.
notes: Expansion 2. Price not captured.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 30 tiles, a dragon that eats meeples, a fairy that protects them, the princess and magic portals.
what_it_fixes: Adds lots of tiles and ways to knock rivals out of features.
verdict_reason: Princess & Dragon is great for groups that want more chaos. Tile-placement purists may not enjoy the dragon.
notes: Expansion 3. More take-that.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 18 tiles, 30 tower floors to capture rival meeples, and a tile dispenser tower.
what_it_fixes: Adds direct take-that play for competitive groups.
verdict_reason: The Tower lets players capture each other's meeples, which many experienced players don't like. Skip it unless your group enjoys take-that play.
notes: Expansion 4. Direct conflict.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 12 tiles, abbey tiles to fill holes, plus mayor, wagon and barn pieces.
what_it_fixes: Makes hard-to-finish features easier to close.
verdict_reason: Abbey & Mayor is solid but not essential. Get it after the first few expansions if you want more meeple options.
notes: Expansion 5.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 22 tiles, the city of Carcassonne with the Count, and King/Robber bonus tiles for biggest city and longest road.
what_it_fixes: Adds biggest-city and longest-road style bonuses.
verdict_reason: Count, King & Robber is a value box of several small add-ons. It's good if you want lots of variety for the price.
notes: Expansion 6.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 12 tiles, castles that grow small cities, bazaar tile auctions, and 12 wooden bridges.
what_it_fixes: Rescues awkward road and small-city spots; adds auctions.
verdict_reason: Bridges, Castles & Bazaars is worth it once you've exhausted Inns and Traders. The tile auctions suit groups that like bidding.
notes: Publisher calls it the eighth expansion. Expansion 7 not listed on Z-Man site.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 18 tiles, hills that break ties, vineyards near monasteries, and a shepherd with a sheep/wolf bag.
what_it_fixes: Adds a push-your-luck choice and a tie-breaker on hills.
verdict_reason: Hills & Sheep is fine to own eventually but not essential. The sheep add a light push-your-luck twist.
notes: Ninth expansion per publisher.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Carcassonne base game.
what_it_adds: 20 tiles, circus and acrobat tiles, animal tokens and ringmaster meeples.
what_it_fixes: Adds circus clustering bonuses; little core fix.
verdict_reason: Under the Big Top has fans, but it's hard to find and not essential. Skip it unless you spot it at a fair price.
notes: Tenth expansion. Z-Man buy link says CURRENTLY UNAVAILABLE — check stock before listing.
